original.discovery_notes: Called immediately before 0x8800700c by all three known callers. The name describes the observed pool behavior and remains subject to refinement as the complete object model is recovered.

commands: flatpak run org.mamedev.MAME kinst -rompath assets/ki1 -debug -nodrc -debugscript mame/oracle_ki15d_880053f4.cmd -video none -sound none -nothrottle -skip_gameinfo -seconds_to_run 4 -cfg_directory work/mame/cfg -diff_directory work/mame/diff
verification.notes: Four controlled R4600 calls cover a free first record, one occupied record, the last of 29 searchable records, and the all-occupied fallthrough record. The native test compares the complete 1 MiB mapped RAM image after each call.
